name: io.github.kanywst/mcp-opa-authz
description: Authorization answers from real policy code: evaluate Rego locally, or ask an AuthZEN 1.0 PDP.

environmentVariables.name: AUTHZEN_PDP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Default AuthZEN Access Evaluation endpoint, e.g. https://pdp.example.com/access/v1/evaluation. Only evaluate_policy works without it.

environmentVariables.name: AUTHZEN_PDP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Authorization header value for the PDP. A value with no scheme is sent as "Bearer <token>".

environmentVariables.name: AUTHZEN_PDP_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout for PDP calls, as a Go duration. Default 10s.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OPA_EVAL_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Wall-clock limit on a single Rego evaluation, as a Go duration. Default 5s.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OPA_ALLOW_NETWORK_BUILTINS
environmentVariables.description: Re-enable http.send, net.lookup_ip_addr and opa.runtime inside evaluated policies. Off by default: policy source evaluated here comes from a model and runs inside the server process.
